rubric: Defines separate agents (or agent instances) for the write and read interfaces
The read-side agent actively drives rd_ready back-pressure rather than only monitoring
Has a scoreboard that checks read data and the last flag against written data, in order
Defines a sequence item with data and last fields
Includes coverage of the full and empty conditions
States that a register model is not applicable (no software-visible registers)
Includes a test with simultaneous reads and writes
In the build order, some step that runs a test comes before the step that adds the scoreboard
